definition: to live and eat in someone else's home
description: A cosy farmhouse kitchen with a black range cooker, copper pots and a dresser full of blue and white plates. A young man in a winter jacket and yellow scarf, his suitcase beside him, sits at a long pine table with a young woman in a lilac hoodie. A young woman with a red braid serves him a tall stack of pancakes and he starts to cut them, while a young man pours tea from a brown teapot. A cat jumps down from the dresser, a jug of orange juice stands on the table and snow lies outside.

taps.phrase: to pour tea from a teapot
taps.target: the man in the checked shirt
